concerns.text: FR‑004 in the spec mandates Type I error estimation by shuffling group labels on real data. The plan amends this to use simulated‑null datasets (see ‘Mapping Functional Requirements (FR‑004 (amended))’) without updating the spec, creating a contradiction between spec and plan.

FR‑008 in the spec requires a Friedman test for assessing transformation effects, but the plan replaces this with a GLMM (binomial) in Task T024. The spec is not amended to reflect this methodological change, violating requirement consistency.

The plan introduces a GLMM analysis step (Task T024) but no corresponding contract or data‑model entity is defined for GLMM results, leaving the output undocumented and unvalidated against any schema.
